infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Cleaner Neat scans your photos and videos on-device to find duplicates, similar shots, screenshots and large videos you can remove to free up storage.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Cleaner Neat needs access to manage the photos you choose to clean up.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Cleaner Neat checks your contacts on-device to find duplicates and incomplete entries you can merge or remove.
